title: Kanban flashcards: the Kanban Guide, for PK I
description: The whole Kanban Guide (May 2025) as flashcards: flow, the Definition of Workflow, WIP, the four flow metrics and how to use them, each idea taught before it is tested.

changelog.notes: First draft, not yet released: awaiting the independent audit, a newcomer read-through and an expert review.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 314 cards against the Kanban Guide (May 2025), for accuracy and for plain language
checks.result: It found no card wrong. Four claims the Guide does not support, one ambiguous card, eight unclear ones and 41 minor issues were fixed.
